script.spoken: Fatigue cracks grew until the bulkhead burst. A jumbo jet's tail fin blew off in flight. Thirty two minutes later, it crashed into a mountain, and five hundred twenty people died. The failure started seven years earlier. After a tail strike, a pressure bulkhead was repaired. The repair used one row of rivets where two were needed. Escaping air tore off the fin and cut the hydraulics. Repairs are now checked against their approved design.
